title: The Bottle That Sank The Lighthouse
premise: A reclusive lighthouse keeper discovers a message in a bottle that predicts the exact time of the next high tide, but the tide is rising unnaturally fast, defying all logic.

title: The Girl Who Found His Silence
premise: A lonely elderly man's rigid routine is disrupted by a curious child, forcing him to confront a forgotten chapter of his life.

title: The Canvas That Painted Her Future
premise: A sleep-deprived artist discovers her dreams are actually recordings of a future she hasn't lived yet, and she is the one causing them.

title: She Read Her Mother's Future... And Saw Her Own End
premise: A grieving daughter returns to her childhood home and discovers a diary that describes her life with impossible accuracy, eventually predicting her future actions.

title: The Man Who Feared His Own House
premise: A hypochondriac inherits a 'haunted' mansion, but the 'ghost' is just a desperate real estate agent.

title: Her Future Self's Frantic Warning
premise: A shy librarian and a chaotic time traveler team up to fix a tiny mistake that ruined a life, but the cost of fixing it might be worse than the regret.

title: The Splicer Who tried to Hack the Sky
premise: A corrupt politician who profits from covering up environmental pollution finally faces the consequences when the toxicity catches up to him.

title: He Returned Home... But The Town Wanted To Keep Him
premise: A prodigal son returns to his rural hometown to sell his father's house, only to find the entire town has been obsessively preserving his childhood for a secret purpose.

title: She Faked a Well, Then the AI Watched
premise: An influencer fakes a heartwarming philanthropic act for views, but the recipient is an AI testing human gullibility.

title: The Midnight Footsteps In Her Room
premise: A teenager investigates rhythmic midnight footsteps that sync with her own heartbeat, only to discover the true source hiding in plain sight.

title: The Gallery Mask That Erased His Face
premise: A detective with hyperthymesia (perfect recall of faces) investigates a faceless murder, only to realize the clues point to their own forgotten past.

title: The Mirror That Ate Her Brother
premise: A young grieving sister sees her deceased brother's reflection in every mirror, but the reflection starts giving her life advice she never received from him while he was alive.
